title: Emerald Lane rollout checklist and ops calendar - 2026-09 (draft)
content:
Purpose and scope:
This doc is a working runbook for the Emerald Lane feature rollout (codename). It combines the tactical preflight checklist, a one-week ops calendar for the rollout window, and an initial draft of release notes for product and infra teams. Target audience: release conductor, on-call SREs, serving-runtime owners, and product launch lead.

High-level goals:
- Deploy Emerald Lane (model routing + smart fallback) to ~10% traffic in US-EAST on Day 0, then ramp to 50% over 72h if signals are green.
- Ensure no latency regressions > 15% p95 and no increase in error-rate > 0.2% on API surface.
- Validate fallback and canary-to-primary promotion within 10 minutes if anomalies detected.

Quick notes to self (open questions):
- Can we reduce the initial batch size for the new kernel selection path? (ping runtime team)
- Confirm cost-accounting tags will be attached to Emerald Lane requests for Dedicated customers.
- Need legal sign-off on telemetry retention change for 7d -> 14d (w/ privacy).

Preflight checklist (must be green before any traffic shift):
[ ] Release artifacts built and archived (s3://releases/emerald-lane/2026-09-14)
[ ] Smoke docker images validated locally and in staging (logs show kernel handshake OK)
[ ] Canary deployment in staging completed, 48h stability, perf snapshot saved
[ ] Automated evals: quality regression tests run with baseline prompts, no >2% drop in ROUGE-like metric
[ ] Observability: dashboards created and pinned -> latency/p95, error-rate, fallback-rate, model-variant-splits
[ ] Alerting: pages configured for latency-surge, error-explosion, fallback-threshold (pager duty escalation)
[ ] Rollback artifacts: deployment tags and oldest stable image recorded (image: prod-stable-2026-08-30)
[ ] KB and runbook updated (this file -> mark final once locked)
[ ] Stakeholder comms: announce to #release-orchestra and SRE on-call 24h prior

Cutover run steps (Day 0, short checklist):
1) 09:00 UTC - Preflight sanity: run smoke test script (scripts/release/smoke_emerald.sh) -> must pass in 5m
2) 09:15 UTC - Kickoff call (15m) with owners: release conductor, runtime, SRE, product PM, solutions eng
3) 09:30 UTC - Switch routing rule: route 0.5% -> Emerald Lane variant A; verify traffic metrics for 15m
4) 10:00 UTC - If stable, increase to 2% for next 30m; monitor p95 and errors every 5m
5) 10:40 UTC - Increase to 10% if no alerts. If alert triggers at any point, execute rollback play (below)
6) 12:00 UTC - Snapshot telemetry & cost sample; announce first status update to stakeholders

Ramp policy (automated manual hybrid):
- Manual ramp steps at 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50%
- Minimum observation window: 30m at each step until 10%, then 1h windows above 10%
- Automated guardrails: if p95 > baseline*1.15 or error_rate increase > 0.002 anytime in window, auto-throttle back one step and page SRE

Rollback procedure (fast path):
- Trigger: alert fires for latency or error thresholds or spike in fallback-rate > 3x baseline in 15m
- Action: route all Emerald Lane traffic back to previous model variant (route-manager rollback command)
- Post-rollback: collect traces for the 30m window that led to trigger, open an incident in JIRA (JIRA-REL-XXXX), notify product and infra leads
- If rollback unsuccessful: escalate to SRE lead, enable slowpath (all requests to queued fallback with reduced concurrency)

Ops calendar (concise week view - local times in US-EAST):
- Mon 2026-09-13: Final dry-run in staging at 14:00 local. Confirm alerts and runbook owners.
- Tue 2026-09-14 (Day 0): Release window 09:00-13:00 UTC. Kickoff + incremental ramp to 10% by 11:00. Nightwatch: minimal traffic until Tuesday 23:00.
- Wed 2026-09-15: Monitor ramping to 25% between 09:00-13:00 UTC if green. Midday sync at 13:30.
- Thu 2026-09-16: Ramp to 50% after 09:00 UTC if no issues. Product verification window 14:00-16:00.
- Fri 2026-09-17: If stable, keep 50% and run extended A/B evals; prepare notes for release notes PR.
- Sat-Sun: Standby SRE rotation (on-call only) for emergency rollback; no scheduled ramps.

Communications plan:
- T-minus 48h: Short heads-up in #release-orchestra and email to list (release-conductor@redwood.com). Include the runbook link.
- T-minus 24h: Post final checklist completion; confirm on-call roster.
- Hourly cadence during Day 0: channel updates (every hour) until ramp to 50% or full stop.
- Post-release: summary email and quick retrospective invite 48h after Day 0.

Monitoring signals and thresholds (owner in parentheses):
- API p95 latency (serving-runtime): baseline = 120ms; alert if > 138ms (15% uplift) sustained 10m
- 5xx error rate (api-gateway): baseline = 0.05%; page if > 0.25% in 10m
- Fallback-rate (routing): baseline = 0.6%; page if > 3% in 15m
- Token generation cost/sample (billing): monitor for 10%+ unit cost increase
- Quality regressions (evals): any test in the golden set dropping >2.5% requires immediate hold

Release notes (draft — for product + ops):
Emerald Lane (experimental) — Sept 2026
Summary: Emerald Lane introduces traffic-aware model routing with fast fallback. It improves average cost-per-token by enabling per-request model variant selection and reduces tail latency for common short-sequence requests.
Highlights:
- Smart routing: requests are classified and routed to an optimal model variant based on locality and prompt shape.
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to stable variant when qps or latency thresholds are exceeded.
- Opt-in control: customers on Dedicated can opt into Emerald Lane per-route via console toggle.
Known limitations:
- Some long-context workloads may see reduced throughput until kernel tuning completes.
- Initial rollout is US-EAST only and limited to public Hosted customers.
Upgrade/caveats for Ops:
- New metrics: fallback-rate and variant-split must be added to per-route dashboards.
- Cost accounting: expect a temporary bump in per-token sampling due to dual-variant telemetry during ramp.

Post-launch tasks (first 7 days):
- Day+1: Full telemetry export and cost delta analysis (billing + infra)
- Day+2: Quality sweep and prompt-set re-run (product + applied-ml)
- Day+3: Documentation PR for console controls and customer-facing notes
- Day+7: Retrospective and decision: continue ramp to 100% or schedule rollback paths

Appendix: short checklist for on-call responders
- If paged for latency: check p95 dashboard, inspect top 5 slow endpoints, verify Emerald Lane variant split
- If paged for errors: switch to fallback-only routing for 10m, gather request ids (trace-id header), escalate if >1% 5xx
- If uncertain: call release-conductor or SRE lead, do NOT roll forward changes to routing until cleared

Field notes (freeform):
- Liang flagged an SLO gap last week w/ longer tail on small models — watch for tokenization regressions.
- Riley: prepare a short script to diffuse traffic into low-latency backends if emergent surge occurs.

End of draft. This is intentionally terse and conversational — will flesh into a polished runbook once preflight artifacts are green.

CHANGELOG (doc edits):
- 2026-09-03 - initial sketch (Aisha)
- 2026-09-07 - added rollback fast path + thresholds (Marco)
- 2026-09-10 - updated calendar and linked artifacts, expanded release notes draft (Aisha)
